title: Cyber Preparedness & Data Backup
description: Covers what to back up and the 3-2-1 rule, encrypted USB drives, offline password management with KeePass, and scanning identity documents securely. Also includes phone hardening, prioritizing device charging, off-grid messaging with Meshtastic, Briar, and two-way radios, and common post-disaster scams.
shortDescription: 3-2-1 backups, encrypted USBs, KeePass, phone hardening, mesh messaging
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
